risks.risk: Brake performance may be weak (pads worn, warped rotor/rim, or cable issues).
risks.proof: Short video of a safe test: squeeze brake levers while stationary and then a slow roll test showing the bike stops quickly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as brakes not confirmed (worst case: needs brake service/parts).

risks.risk: Gear shifting may be faulty (skipping, misalignment, bent derailleur, worn chain/cassette).
risks.proof: Video showing shifting through all gears under pedaling, plus a close-up photo of the derailleur and shifter markings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as gears not confirmed (worst case: may need adjustment or chain/gear replacement).

risks.risk: Folding hinge/frame alignment issues (play in hinge, cracks near joints).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the folding hinge and frame joints from both sides, plus a video showing the fold/unfold with no wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as structural condition not confirmed (worst case: hinge/frame may need repair).

risks.risk: Tyre condition may be poor (dry rot, bald tread, punctures/sidewall cracks).
risks.proof: Close-up of tyre tread and sidewalls on both wheels, and a photo of any puncture patches; ideally a quick ride video.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tyres not confirmed (worst case: tyres may need replacement).

risks.risk: Wheel true/straightness (rims may be bent causing wobble).
risks.proof: Spin test video showing rim wobble, plus close-up of rim edges.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as wheel condition not confirmed (worst case: wheel truing needed).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of the frame branding/serial area and the folding hinge/joints (both sides).
Video of brakes: stationary squeeze test and a slow roll stop test.
Video of gear shifting through all gears while pedaling, plus close-up of derailleur and shifters.
Close-up photos of tyre tread and sidewalls on both wheels.
Wheel spin test video to check for wobble.
response.reason: From photo 0, it’s clearly a folding bicycle, but the key details needed to price it safely (exact brand/model, brake function, gear condition, and structural/hinge integrity) are not verifiable remotely. Request the proof items first, then price at the worst-case condition if any test fails.
